readerCopy.body: Formal authority can collide with a person or institution powerful enough to operate around the rule. When Saturn opposes Pluto, enforcement and concentrated leverage face each other directly, exposing the difference between who officially decides and who can afford to ignore the decision. Money, access, and private consequences can make enforcement selective. A rule has more meaning when the limit applies to the powerful office or institution as well as to the person easiest to punish.
